description: Identifier check digits: IBAN, ISBN, GTIN, VIN, ISIN, LEI and more, in a batch — Validates the format and check digit of up to 100 identifiers per call, for an agent about to put an IBAN, ISBN, GTIN/EAN/UPC, container number, VIN, ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, LEI, IMO number, BIC or Luhn number into a payment, order or record. Each item is {kind, value}; with kind omitted the engine proposes candidate kinds and answers unknown if two kinds both validate. Reports the normalized form (lo

kind.description: iban, iso6346 (container), gtin (8/12/13/14), isbn10, isbn13, issn, vin, isin, cusip, sedol, lei, imo, bic (ISO 9362 format only), luhn. Omit to auto-detect (luhn is never auto-detected).
